Ticket:
Inquiry regarding electronic lab order submission and error handling

Dear Support Team, we are writing to request guidance on generating and submitting electronic lab orders through the system. Specifically, our staff needs clarification on the proper workflow for selecting diagnostic test panels, appending the correct ICD-10 diagnosis codes, and transmitting the requisition to our reference laboratory. We recently experienced a rejected lab order for a patient and wish to ensure our process aligns with system requirements. Thank you for your assistance.
